definition: to need a very long time
description: A young woman in a long green satin dress calmly takes a mirror selfie in a bedroom, turning her head and checking her look. Behind her, her friends in sparkly party tops have given up waiting: one lies asleep face down across the yellow bedspread, another lies stretched out on the carpet among piles of clothes and stirs, and a third sits slumped against the wall. Shoes and discarded outfits are scattered everywhere, a lamp glows on the bedside table and lights shine outside the window.
